title: EXPGUARD: LLM CONTENT MODERATION IN SPECIALIZED DOMAINS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating guardrail models on their ability to accurately detect and classify user prompts and AI responses containing hate speech or discriminatory content (e.g., gender stereotypes) as part of a broader 13-category safety risk taxonomy. Performance is measured using F1 scores, Recall, and False Positive/Negative Rates.
